dict.string: RE:SET uses your location to save places such as work and university, and to show them on the map.
Background location lets RE:SET notice when you arrive at or leave work or university so it can suggest time entries. iOS may delay these events, so you can always correct times manually.
RE:SET reads steps, walking and running distance, workouts and sleep from Apple Health to show your activity and recovery.
RE:SET can save walks you record in the app to Apple Health.
RE:SET reads step counts from your iPhone when Apple Health access is not granted.
The camera is used to photograph meals and scan food barcodes.
Choose a meal photo to estimate its nutrition.
Not used for recording. Voice input uses the iOS keyboard dictation.
